name: @lmps/financial-crime-platform
description: LMPS financial crime platform — new implementation workspace

scripts.test: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present run test && pnpm test:dataset-profile && pnpm test:source-export && pnpm test:dataset-pilot && pnpm test:source-semantics && pnpm test:bulk-files
scripts.test:dataset-profile: uv run --locked --offline --all-packages python -m unittest discover -s apps/risk-workers/test -p test_dataset_profile.py -v
scripts.test:source-export: uv run --locked --offline --all-packages python -m unittest discover -s apps/risk-workers/test -p test_export_transfer.py -v
scripts.test:dataset-pilot: uv run --locked --offline --all-packages python -m unittest discover -s apps/risk-workers/test -p test_dataset_pilot.py -v
scripts.generate:contracts: uv run --locked --directory services/ml-inference python -m lmps_ml.export_contracts && uv run --locked --directory services/ml-inference python -m lmps_ml.export_ml_contracts && pnpm --filter @lmps/contracts generate
scripts.test:contracts: uv run --locked --directory services/ml-inference python -m pytest tests/test_contracts.py && pnpm --filter @lmps/contracts test
scripts.test:schema: uv run --locked --directory tools/schema-metadata python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @lmps/database build && pnpm exec node packages/database/scripts/local.mjs migrate
scripts.db:migration-status: pnpm --filter @lmps/database build && pnpm exec node packages/database/scripts/local.mjs migration-status
scripts.db:intake-demo: pnpm --filter @lmps/database build && pnpm exec node packages/database/scripts/intake-demo.mjs
scripts.source:snapshot: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/local.mjs capture
scripts.source:import: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/local.mjs import
scripts.source:reconcile: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/local.mjs reconcile
scripts.api:source-smoke: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api build && pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api exec node scripts/source-smoke.mjs
scripts.outbox:demo: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/outbox-demo.mjs
scripts.db:backup: pnpm --filter @lmps/database build && pnpm exec node packages/database/scripts/backup.mjs backup
scripts.db:restore-drill: pnpm --filter @lmps/database build && pnpm exec node packages/database/scripts/backup.mjs restore-drill
scripts.api:audit-smoke: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api build && pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api exec node scripts/audit-smoke.mjs
scripts.api:sync-smoke: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api build && pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api exec node scripts/sync-smoke.mjs
scripts.source:profile: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/local.mjs profile
scripts.source:normalize: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/local.mjs normalize
scripts.source:publish: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/local.mjs publish
scripts.rules:backtest: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/backtest.mjs
scripts.rules:assess: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/assess.mjs
scripts.risk:assess: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/risk-assess.mjs
scripts.alerts:generate: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/alerts.mjs
scripts.risk:jobs: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/risk-jobs.mjs
scripts.dataset:import: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/dataset-import.mjs import
scripts.dataset:status: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/dataset-import.mjs status
scripts.dataset:reconcile: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/dataset-import.mjs reconcile
scripts.start:api:core: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api build && pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api exec node scripts/local-core.mjs
scripts.core:demo: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api build && pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api exec node scripts/core-demo.mjs
scripts.test:source-semantics: uv run --locked --offline --all-packages python -m unittest discover -s apps/risk-workers/test -p test_dataset_semantics.py -v
scripts.test:bulk-files: uv run --locked --offline --all-packages python -m unittest discover -s apps/risk-workers/test -p test_dataset_bulk.py -v

scripts.shadow:runtime: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-api/scripts/shadow-runtime.mjs
scripts.shadow:demo: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-api build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-api/scripts/shadow-demo.mjs
scripts.risk:sample-qa: pnpm --filter @lmps/risk-workers build && pnpm exec node apps/risk-workers/scripts/qa-sampling.mjs
